title: Terminal · {name}
subtitle: MVP uses the owner session. Device pairing codes come later.
pushDesc: Orders matter: install the app icon and enable Push. Don't rely on a tab staying open.
pushIosHint: On iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
pushDesktopHint: Use the browser menu “Install app” / “Add to Home screen”.
pushIosInstall: iOS needs Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the app icon.
pushNoSupport: This browser does not support Web Push.
pushIosOnlyPwa: iOS only delivers Push after installing as PWA: Safari → Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
pushConfirmed: Notifications confirmed. This device can receive orders in the background.
pushDenied: You blocked notifications. Re-enable them in browser settings.
pushNoVapid: Server VAPID is not configured. Check .dev.vars.
pushEnabled: Push enabled. Tap “Send test”, then open the notification to confirm.
pushTestSent: Test sent. If it shows on a locked screen — open the notification to confirm.
